label: <DEL> step of length-9 sequences (sparse, content-dependent subset)
explanation: Fires almost only at the <DEL> step (t=9) of the longest (L=9) sequences: about 95% of activations and 96% of mass. A few weak hits occur at t=8 (the <DEL> of L=8 sequences, or the last original token of L=9). It never fires during the copy phase or on earlier original steps. It fires on only about 2.3% of L=9 <DEL> steps, though, and which ones depends on content. Rates are higher when the last original token (prev_tok) is e/v/j/u/n and the first token is w/c/1/0/v/q/2/u. Adding those conditions brings dev F1 only to about 0.29, so the selection rule is not captured. Magnitude is small (max 0.015). Its modulators were not established beyond these token enrichments.
